Lobo.name: Lobo
Lobo.summary: Lobo is an unreleased Mega Drive fighting game developed by Ocean of America. It is based off the DC Comics book series of the same name, and was due to be released in the Winter of 1996. A Super Nintendo version was also planned, but both copies were cancelled last minute.

Lost Vikings, The.name: The Lost Vikings
Lost Vikings, The.summary: The Mega Drive/Genesis version contains five stages not present in any other version of the game.
